faqs.question: How much does a custom NDT reporting solution cost?
faqs.answer: It varies significantly based on scope. Simple single-report automation might be $3-5K. Complex multi-method platforms with mobile apps and cloud integration could be $20-50K+. I provide detailed quotes after understanding your requirements.

faqs.question: How long does implementation typically take?
faqs.answer: Most projects are 4-8 weeks from kickoff to deployment. Simple report automation can be faster (2-3 weeks), while enterprise platforms may take 12-16 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! I've worked with clients across different countries and time zones. Communication is via email, WhatsApp, and video calls - very flexible scheduling.

faqs.question: What if our requirements change during development?
faqs.answer: I use an agile approach with regular check-ins. Minor adjustments are normal and expected. Major scope changes are discussed and may adjust timeline/pricing.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing support and updates?
faqs.answer: Yes! I offer support packages for bug fixes, updates to codes/standards, feature enhancements, and technical assistance. Details discussed during project scoping.

faqs.question: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Most likely, yes. I've integrated with ERP, CMMS, databases, and inspection equipment. Share your system details and we'll determine the best approach.

faqs.question: Do we own the source code?
faqs.answer: Yes, for custom development projects, you own the code. For platform licenses (like MASSA), you license the software but don't own the underlying code.
